title: Fewest-Letter Chain Splice
description:
## Task

Splice all the words into one string that contains every word as a run of consecutive characters, and make that string as short as possible. Words may overlap where the end of one matches the start of the next, and a word that already sits inside another word costs nothing extra. Return only the shortest possible length.

## Input

- `words` — a list of non-empty lowercase words. It may be empty and may contain repeats.

## Output

The length of the shortest string that contains every word. An empty list gives `0`.

## Example

```python
shortest_splice_length(["cat", "tac"])  # returns 5  ("catac")
shortest_splice_length(["ab", "bc", "ca"])  # returns 4  ("abca")
shortest_splice_length(["abc", "bc"])  # returns 3
```

## Constraints

- 0 ≤ number of words ≤ 12
- 1 ≤ length of each word ≤ 12
- Words contain only the lowercase letters `a`-`z`.
- Trying every order of the words is too slow for the largest inputs.
